title: Smokepowder Satchel
summary: Throw or ignite this container for an explosive blast.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw range depends on Strength and weight, up to 60 ft. Breaking it creates a flammable Smokepowder surface.
fields.Detonate: Fire damage detonates it. 10 ft radius, 3d4 + 9 Force, DC 12 Dexterity save for half. Pushes targets 10 ft without a save and automatically crits objects.
fields.Surface ignition: Ignition of the spilled Smokepowder deals 2d6 Force and 2d6 Fire. A separate DC 12 Dexterity save negates the Fire damage. The surface then becomes Fire and immediately applies Burning. Force damage alone can also ignite the spill.
fields.Edge case: The spill ignition and detonation are distinct. Targets at the edge may be hit by the blast without being hit by the ignition.
fields.Durability note: The item page lists 4 HP under the spill section without clarifying whether it applies to the container or the spill.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
